hypothesis: Per-item state evolution can change the retention-adaptation-recovery trade-off; learning, continuity and superiority are separate hypotheses.

common.stable_query_fraction_sensitivity: match stable item fraction; separately labeled
common.selection: Validation only; include initialization; equal training trajectories and optimizer-update budget per learned method. Freeze checkpoints before any primary test.
common.primary_eviction: deterministic minimum score; random baseline uniform; ties by predeclared shared hash
common.training_decisions: Use the same causal state transition and hard storage limits, with stochastic eviction for policy-gradient exploration. Select checkpoints on deterministic deployment validation; report stochastic-versus-deterministic gap separately. No differentiating through argmin or claiming identical action distributions.
common.legacy_eviction_sensitivity: shared softmax(-score/0.5) on a separately labeled subset
common.retrieval: newest retained observed version; identical index and optional observed-version rejection for every method
common.budget: resident content slots; report state, index, latent and content bytes separately; no byte-efficiency claim
common.test_policy: Test-world seeds and files are reserved until implementation checks and validation choices are locked. Fresh schedules, not a new independent source corpus.

baseline_contract.fixed_decay: exp(-lambda*age since observation); no retrieval reset or successful-feedback strength bonus. For deterministic minimum scoring every positive lambda has the same ordering; include zero-decay tie control and archive the legacy reinforced baseline separately.
baseline_contract.frequency: one insertion count plus successful retrieval attempts regardless of feedback correctness; no confidence or context term
baseline_contract.lru: evict least recently accessed item; observations and returned retrievals update access time
baseline_contract.random: uniform random eviction among the same eligible candidates
baseline_contract.linear: same 40-D causal inputs and utility training; linear insertion coefficients with fixed subsequent decay; no per-item post-insertion reprioritization
baseline_contract.gru: same inputs, training budget and output head; existing hidden size8; insertion coefficients with fixed subsequent decay
baseline_contract.adaptive_evolution: frozen four-state equations and123parameter coefficient head; update resident states; no extra hidden network
baseline_contract.adaptive_rule: same four-state evolution with fixed validation-selected coefficients; no learned network

causal_controls.definition: Uses the same observable context, observed-version consistency and bounded usage metadata to score current relevance, without a continuous or learned latent transition.
causal_controls.admission_schedule: shared causally predetermined candidate-admission masks for all methods; same slots, forced write/eviction opportunities and event times
causal_controls.budget_selection: compare all registered budgets; any chosen match uses validation only, never future test eviction counts
causal_controls.caution: Equal attempted admissions or forced eviction opportunities do not imply equal actual resident replacement when a policy rejects the new candidate; report realized counts and overlapping-rate strata. No oracle replay of adaptive future evictions.

metrics.accuracy: all correct queries / all queries; separately report balanced stable/volatile macro accuracy
metrics.adaptation_lag: number of target-query opportunities to two consecutive4-query windows >=75%; unrecovered censored at T=20
metrics.adaptation_score: 1-min(lag,T)/T, report censoring/success separately; undefined in stationary episodes without a genuine change; minimum measurable lag5 means score ceiling0.75
metrics.stale_error: answered obsolete versions / all queries; abstentions separate; off-topic answers and superseded versions are distinct
metrics.pre_reminder_recovery: correct old-topic return queries before any fact refresh / all such queries
metrics.post_reminder_recovery: correct return queries after reminders / all such queries, with lag from first reminder
metrics.acquisition_speed: query opportunities after first new-version observation until first correct new-version answer; censor misses
metrics.retrieval_relevance: correct target-bearing retrieved evidence / all returned evidence
metrics.memory_utilization: current-workload-relevant occupied slots / occupied slots; not accuracy, alongside historical stable retention
metrics.noise_degradation: accuracy_clean-accuracy_corrupt on exactly paired world/query tapes
metrics.resources: wall clock, RSS, content/state/index bytes, writes, evictions, rescoring calls, retrieval calls, API attempts and provider token usage

analysis.unit: world/session cluster; average policy seeds inside world; paired bootstrap10000 with seed901; noise and capacity copies are not independent observations
analysis.primary_contrasts: adaptive_evolution versus each static baseline; adaptive versus instantaneous_context_rule under common admission schedules; always show adaptive_rule/linear/GRU
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction within each batch's registered primary comparisons for inferential p-values; unadjusted descriptive intervals labeled exploratory
analysis.tradeoff: plot stable_retention against adaptation_score; fixed predeclared retention-cost sweep [0,.25,.5,1,2] at equal budgets; each point requires its own equal-budget validation/training across learned methods, not posthoc reweighting of the same predictions
analysis.retention_constraint: exploratory validation-selected floor: SR >= fixed_decay_SR-0.02; report feasibility and test constraint violations, never label an infeasible point successful
analysis.mechanism_panels: preselect item IDs from smoke schedules before primary tests; all methods same items; I,C,U,T plus presence/eviction, context and feedback; missing states after eviction shown as gaps, reobservations marked as new insertions
analysis.claim_limit: A tradeoff alone does not establish novelty. Do not describe all existing agent memory systems as static without a separate literature review. Continuous-versus-discrete superiority needs matched step and cost controls.

batches.name: Freeze and protocol preparation
batches.exit_gate: Archive hashes match; no changes to v1 results; plan fields validate; no new training or API calls.

batches.name: Stable/volatile mixture and replacement attribution
steps: Implement independent80-key generator and all8method adapters without editing frozen v1.
Smoke-test ratios, query balance, causal cues, capacity, true stale errors and erased content.
Train shared core controllers on train mixture+cyclic schedules; lock validation choices and baseline ordering.
Run only registered mixture test cells, then aggregate all outcomes and replacement controls.
batches.exit_gate: Accept positive, null or negative outcome; require identical information/budgets, no leakage, complete stable/volatile metrics and auditable actual replacement counts. Attribution unresolved if instantaneous rule matches evolution.

current_user_approved_protocol.legacy_prepare_scope: The older ratio/capacity/training plan remains separate; use this independent protocol for the current pressure-dynamics experiment.

batches.name: Capacity response curve
steps: Reuse exactly B1 test worlds and locked controllers.
Run missing4/64slot cells; deduplicate8/16/32cells by configuration/data hashes.
Plot accuracy, retention, stale error and adaptation versus capacity, including realized occupancy and80-key working-set pressure.
batches.exit_gate: 5point response curve, not a fitted universal scaling law; capacities4/64 are marked outside training capacities; no retraining on observed test failures.

batches.name: Cyclic reactivation
steps: Evaluate locked core controllers on held-out A-B-A schedules with equalized access counts and selected dormant lengths.
Query A before reminders; separately introduce reminders and measure recovery speed.
Audit that an evicted item cannot recover content from metadata; visualize preselected same-item lifetimes.
batches.exit_gate: Separate content survival, recall before reminder and reacquisition after reminder; negative no-reminder results constrain the claim rather than trigger test-set tuning.

batches.name: Feedback and importance-signal robustness
misleading_conditions: wrong observable topic/importance cue with clean factual content
steps: Create paired corruptions of locked clean trajectories without changing facts or queries.
Evaluate frozen clean-trained controllers; distinguish out-of-distribution feedback from optional noise-trained sensitivity.
Report clean-minus-corrupt degradation, stable retention and stale answers; feedback-independent baselines must remain identical under feedback-only flips.
batches.exit_gate: Corrupted importance cue is a separate axis from correctness-feedback flips; no claim of robustness to factual misinformation.

batches.name: Importance inversion
conditions: demand inversion with unchanged true facts
observed factual supersession with changed answer
steps: Match initial observation age and access counts for A/B; change causal demand cue after warmup.
Evaluate explicit supersession separately so off-topic memory is not mislabeled false knowledge.
Measure adaptation lag, wrong-old-version answers and new-version acquisition with matched replacement controls.
batches.exit_gate: All8baselines remain included, not just the three convenient comparisons; target facts and change points never enter model inputs as evaluation labels.

batches.name: Demand conditioning and mechanism ablations
steps: Preserve8baseline results as anchors; remove each state from both transition and retention scoring, with neutral replacement documented.
Run fixed-weight interventions for direct sensitivity and equal-budget retrained variants separately.
Compare equal elapsed-time discrete/continuous integration, normalized scores and update costs; exact interval flow is not evidence of neural superiority.
Evaluate actual observed-query-conditioned updates separately from advance reliable agenda cues.
batches.exit_gate: Document effective information/parameter changes; same newly reserved ablation test seeds if design changes after earlier batches; never infer continuous-time necessity from generic context dependence.

batches.name: Language-memory transfer and agent-facing validation
steps: Reuse local public LME/LoCoMo with explicit prior-exposure labels, not fresh-blind-test claims.
Resolve exact MemoryBench repository/version/license/task definition before enabling its adapter; never silently substitute MemOps.
Use common semantic extraction, reader, prompt and token budget across methods; reserve conversation-level splits and freeze retrieval parameters.
Evaluate preference, updates, contradiction and multi-session categories only when supported by actual dataset labels; missing labels are NA.
Keep answer provider cache, retries and shared<=10attempts/rolling60s limiter; record token costs and request counts, then run pilot before larger evaluation.
batches.exit_gate: Real answering evidence required for agent-quality claims; API configuration frozen at execution, no current pricing/free-service assumptions; synthetic proxy results cannot substitute for real answers.
